info.title: probectl provider/management plane API (ee, S-T1)
info.description: The MSP operator surface: tenant lifecycle, fleet-across-tenants health, audited break-glass. Operators are a privilege domain distinct from tenant users (mandatory TOTP MFA); they hold NO implicit access to tenant telemetry — the only telemetry path is an active, tenant-consented, time-bounded grant, and every access is written to the separate provider audit stream.

Verify the first TOTP code, set the password, activate the operator

Provisioning attempts that never completed, with the last step each reached
get.description: Stranded attempts hold a staging row but no routable tenant and no licensed band slot. Each entry reports the furthest provisioning leg completed and the failure that stopped it, so an operator can choose between retrying (the idempotent POST /provider/v1/tenants) and abandoning. Optional older_than (a Go duration) narrows the list.

post.summary: Abandon a stranded provisioning attempt (admin only)
post.description: Tears down whatever external silo state the attempt created, then removes its staging row. Teardown runs first: dropping the row while a per-tenant database survives is precisely the orphan this action exists to prevent. Separately audited on the provider stream.
post.x-probectl-request-body: none: the path identifies the provisioning record

409.description: ir_key_unavailable: the tenant's IR public key (<tenant-uuid>.pem in PROBECTL_IR_PUBLIC_KEY_DIR) is absent; generate it with `probectl audit ir-keygen` and install it with `probectl-control ir-key-install`, then retry

post.x-probectl-request-body: none: the path identifies the grant; revocation takes no parameters

get.summary: THE break-glass telemetry read: requires an ACTIVE consented grant owned by the caller; every access is provider-audited

Page the provider/break-glass audit stream (admin): every operator action, tenant lifecycle step, break-glass request/consent/access/revoke and provisioning outcome; oldest-first after `after`, or newest-first before `before` with order=desc (0 = head). Reads never append to the stream.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: return events with seq greater than this (ascending pages)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: with order=desc: return events with seq lower than this; 0 or absent starts at the head

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: page size (default 50, capped at the audit export page maximum)

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: case-insensitive substring filter on the acting operator

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: case-insensitive substring filter, e.g. breakglass or tenant_provision

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: case-insensitive substring filter on the target (tenant id, grant id, operator id)

200.description: OK: {items: [{seq, actor, action, target, data, prev_hash, hash, created_at}], next: cursor for the following page (last seq returned), order}

403.description: Forbidden: operator is not a provider admin

503.description: audit_read_unavailable: this deployment's sink has no read side

post.summary: IRREVERSIBLE verifiable erasure of a tenant across every store (the CORE S-T5 engine; admin SoD; confirm=<slug>; returns + audits the deletion attestation)

put.summary: Set a tenant's fairness policy override (0 = unlimited / deployment default; enforced on the next admission; audited provider.fairness_set; admin role; blocked by read-only license degrade)

put.summary: Set the tenant's data-governance policy: classification overrides + redaction (redact_from / redact_export); audited provider.governance_set; admin; read-only-degrade blocked

FairnessPolicy.description: Per-tenant fairness override. A missing or 0 field inherits the deployment default; persisted override values must be positive.

OperatorBootstrapRequest.description: Bootstrap the first provider operator. Case-insensitive keys are accepted; the response carries the operator and a one-time enroll_token for TOTP enrollment.

token.description: the deployment bootstrap secret (PROBECTL_PROVIDER_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN); accepted only while no operator exists

OperatorEnrollStartRequest.description: Begin operator enrollment: returns the TOTP secret and otpauth URI to load into an authenticator.

token.description: the one-time enroll token issued at bootstrap or operator creation

OperatorEnrollCompleteRequest.description: Complete enrollment: sets the password and proves TOTP possession; the operator becomes active.

totp.description: a current 6-digit code from the enrolled authenticator (proves the secret was captured)

OperatorLoginRequest.description: Establish an operator session. Throttled per source IP and per account before the credentials are checked.

totp.description: current TOTP code (MFA is mandatory for operators)

OperatorCreateRequest.description: Create another operator (admin only). The response carries a one-time enroll_token to hand to the person out of band.

OperatorStatusRequest.description: Enable or disable an operator; disabling ends every session of that operator immediately.

TenantProvisionRequest.description: Provision a tenant under the licensed tenant band.

slug.description: URL-safe tenant identifier; the identical request resumes an in-progress provision

isolation_model.description: data isolation model for this tenant

residency.description: optional: pins the tenant to a configured data plane / region

BreakGlassRequest.description: Request a time-bounded break-glass grant. It becomes active only after a tenant administrator consents.

tenant_id.description: the tenant whose telemetry the grant would cover

reason.description: free-text justification, written to the provider audit stream

ttl_minutes.description: grant lifetime in minutes; capped by policy

ConsentDecisionRequest.description: A tenant administrator's decision on a pending break-glass request.

TenantQuotasRequest.description: Set per-tenant quotas (fairness/metering). Negative values are rejected.

max_agents.description: cap on enrolled agents; null or omitted clears the cap

max_tests.description: cap on test definitions; null or omitted clears the cap

TenantEraseRequest.description: Verifiable erasure of a tenant's data; the confirmation must repeat the tenant slug.

confirm.description: must equal the tenant slug: the erase is irreversible

redact_from.description: classes at or above this level are redacted

ai_remote_egress.description: tenant consent for sending redacted evidence to a remote AI model
